mapper.select: SELECT tlal.ip, COUNT(tlal.ip) AS count FROM t_link t1 INNER JOIN t_link_access_logs tlal ON t1.full_short_url = tlal.full_short_url WHERE tlal.full_short_url = #{param.fullShortUrl} AND t1.gid = #{param.gid} AND t1.del_flag = 0 AND t1.enable_status = #{param.enableStatus} AND tlal.create_time BETWEEN #{param.startDate} AND #{param.endDate} GROUP BY tlal.full_short_url, t1.gid, tlal.ip ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT tlal.ip, COUNT(tlal.ip) AS count FROM t_link tl INNER JOIN t_link_access_logs tlal ON tl.full_short_url = tlal.full_short_url WHERE tl.gid = #{param.gid} AND tl.del_flag = '0' AND tl.enable_status = '0' AND tlal.create_time BETWEEN #{param.startDate} AND #{param.endDate} GROUP BY tl.gid, tlal.ip ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(tlal.user) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT tlal.user) AS uv, COUNT(DISTINCT tlal.ip) AS uip FROM t_link tl INNER JOIN t_link_access_logs tlal ON tl.full_short_url = tlal.full_short_url WHERE tl.gid = #{param.gid} AND tl.del_flag = '0' AND tl.enable_status = '0' AND tlal.create_time BETWEEN #{param.startDate} AND #{param.endDate} GROUP BY tl.gid;
